description: Annual Leave Planning campaign for one Company × Leave Period. Drives the planning window, employee roster, reminders and submission deadline.

fields.description: Free-text label shown in lists, e.g. “Annual Leave Planning 2026”.
fields.label: Cycle Name

fields.description: Leave Period whose absences the cycle plans for.
fields.label: Leave Period

fields.description: Lifecycle state. Open lets employees file plans; Closed locks new submissions; Archived freezes the compliance snapshot.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Date employees can start filing their Leave Plans.
fields.label: Open Date

fields.description: Last day employees can submit a Leave Plan. Must fall before the Leave Period starts.
fields.label: Submission Deadline

fields.description: Set automatically when the cycle is closed.
fields.label: Close Date

fields.description: Which employees the cycle includes. Choose a narrower scope to skip probationers, contractors, etc.
fields.label: Scope Type
fields.options:
All Employees
By Department
By Designation
By Employee Group

fields.description: Days before the deadline to email employees who haven't submitted. Comma-separated.
fields.label: Employee Reminder Offsets (Days)

fields.description: Days before the deadline to send line managers a digest of non-compliant reports. Comma-separated.
fields.label: Manager Reminder Offsets (Days)

fields.description: When the daily reminder scheduler last processed this cycle.
fields.label: Last Reminder Run At

fields.description: Employee Groups included in this cycle.
fields.label: Employee Groups

fields.options: The compliance roster lists every in-scope employee and their current plan status. It is materialised when the cycle moves to Open. View it via the Leave Planning Cycle Member list, filtered by this cycle.

name: Leave Planning Cycle
